guidelines.title: Unsubstantiated Superiority and Superlative Claims
guidelines.description: Never use unqualified superlatives such as 'the world's most secure cloud' or 'unbreakable protection' without an explicit, verifiable third-party industry benchmark cited in the same paragraph.
guidelines.source_reference: FTC Advertising Substantiation Principles & Legal Governance §2.1
guidelines.principle: Unqualified superlative and superiority claims are prohibited without documented evidence.
guidelines.do_examples: ["Evaluated against industry benchmarks", "Designed with audited defense-in-depth architecture"]

guidelines.title: Forward-Looking ESG & Carbon Milestones
guidelines.description: Claims regarding carbon neutrality or net-zero milestones must explicitly specify the target year, the scope (Scope 1, 2, or 3), and link to the latest audited ESG disclosures.
guidelines.source_reference: EU Green Claims Directive & Northstar ESG Policy §7
guidelines.principle: Environmental claims must include scope and audited validation date.
guidelines.do_examples: ["Targeting Scope 1 and 2 carbon neutrality by 2030 (audited ESG report)"]
guidelines.dont_examples: ["100% green without caveats", "zero carbon impact today"]

guidelines.title: Authoritative & Mathematically Precise Brand Voice
guidelines.description: Brand voice must be authoritative, mathematically precise, humble, and forward-looking. Avoid colloquial hyperbole, sensationalism, and derogatory references to competitors.
guidelines.source_reference: Northstar Brand Identity System v3.0, pg 14-18
guidelines.principle: Speak with rigorous precision and humble authority, avoiding promotional exaggeration.
guidelines.do_examples: ["Northstar delivers 99.95% measured SLA availability across all regions", "Our automated data migration framework reduces cutover time by 25%"]
guidelines.dont_examples: ["miraculous results", "insanely fast", "cheap as dirt", "immediate productivity improvements"]

guidelines.title: Autonomous AI Capabilities and Human Oversight
guidelines.description: Autonomous AI capabilities must always state human oversight safeguards. Never claim 'zero error rate' or '100% hallucinations-free'.

guidelines.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) Alt Text
guidelines.description: All public web and social drafts referencing charts, architectural diagrams, or infographic figures must specify descriptive alternative text for screen readers.

guidelines.title: High Contrast Visual Hierarchy in Collateral
guidelines.description: Maintain at least 4.5:1 text-to-background contrast ratio across all brand documentation and sales decks.

guidelines.title: European Union VAT Disclosure Requirements
guidelines.description: All pricing claims distributed in EU regions must clarify whether pricing is inclusive or exclusive of Value Added Tax (VAT).

guidelines.title: Beta and Preview Feature Disclaimers
guidelines.description: Unreleased and private beta features must never be marketed as production ready without standard experimental preview disclosures.

rules.name: Brand Naming Policy - Northstar Pro
rules.description: Detects disallowed variant product names such as 'Northstar Premium' and 'Northstar Plus' and enforces 'Northstar Pro'.

rules.name: Mandatory SLA Disclaimer Footnote
rules.description: Any public or sales publication mentioning 99.999% uptime SLA must include the mandatory footnote: 'Subject to terms of the Northstar Enterprise SLA Agreement'.
rules.configuration: {"required_disclaimer": "Subject to terms of the Northstar Enterprise SLA Agreement", "trigger_keywords": ["99.999%", "five nines", "uptime SLA"]}

rules.name: Unsubstantiated Superlative Filter
rules.description: Flags marketing claims asserting 'world's most', 'unbreakable', '100% guarantee' without verified third-party evidence.

rules.name: Onboarding Setup Metric Exact Value Check
rules.description: Verifies that onboarding efficiency claims cite the verified benchmark figure of '25%'. Explicitly flags exaggerated claims such as '60%'.

rules.name: Stale Fact & Expired Certification Check
rules.description: Automatically flags citations of expired certifications (e.g., ISO 27001:2013) that have expired.

rules.name: SOC-2 Audit Period Specification Check
rules.description: Requires that any SOC-2 mention must explicitly state 'Type II' and reference ongoing audit periods.

rules.name: Image Accessibility Alt-Text Rule
rules.description: Ensures markdown image inclusions include non-empty descriptive alt-text tags.

rules.name: European Data Sovereignty Regional Policy
rules.description: Ensures all European marketing drafts state data residency in Frankfurt or Dublin data centers.
